4186-4279-6094.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6094.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

1436-5261-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-5261-7014.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

3305-3817-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3305-3817-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-3499-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3499-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4644-6410-7791.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least two Goblins.
4644-6410-7791.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Howlsquad Heavy.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ulrich of the Krallenhorde // Ulrich, Uncontested Alpha

4499-4762-7655.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ulrich.
When Ulrich enters, it triggers, giving Devoted Druid +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
4499-4762-7655.notes: Devoted Druid will gain a net +1/+1 increase each loop, which can add {G} each loop. Once you have infinite mana, Ulrich can instead boost the power and toughness of other creatures.

1247-1528-3298.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
1247-1528-3298.description:
Cast Brightstone Ritual by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Brightstone Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Brightstone Ritual, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

821-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

943-4235-6984.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least five creatures.
943-4235-6984.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Evendo, Waking Haven.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Evendo, Waking Haven
Repeat
943-4235-6984.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of Evendo, Waking Haven.

2167-6557-6939-7380.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Bayou, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Bayou from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bayou enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

650-891-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

465-4681-5147.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

745-5282-7149.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirrorhall Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Mirrorhall Mimic leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirrorhall Mimic from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

486-1129-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
486-1129-1978.description:
Cause Harabaz Druid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-4871-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1605-3011-4090.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
1605-3011-4090.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
1605-3011-4090.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

56-5256-6248-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-5256-6248-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-5256-6248-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

3518-5660-6010.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
When Lion's Eye Diamond enters, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand
Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
413-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2498-6033.description:
Cast Marina Vendrell's Grimoire by paying {5}{U}.
When Marina Vendrell's Grimoire enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw five cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire's second ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers twice.
Repeat from step 4.
2498-6033.notes: This combo will result in you eventually drawing from an empty library, thus losing the game. It is highly recommended to have a way to stop the combo at instant speed or to otherwise stop yourself from losing the game.

2178-3523-4395.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3523-4395.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

681-1637-1669-4423-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1637-1669-4423-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Thaumatog's first ability four times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, giving Thaumatog +4/+4 until end of turn.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

719-3276-3496-4071.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1110-2136.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Terror the Peaks.
When the Terror of the Peaks tokens enter, the nontoken Terror of the Peaks triggers five times, and each Terror of the Peaks token triggers four times.
Resolve all Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 125 damage divided among a maximum of 25 targets.

1283-2011-2803.notablePrerequisites: Mark of Sakiko attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1283-2011-2803.description:
Declare the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached and Najeela, if desired, as attackers.
If Najeela was declared an attacker, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko attached.
The creature triggers, adding at least {5}.
Repeat each combat phases.
If the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached has power six or greater, this combo will net infinite mana.

628-2060-2292.description:
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 until Crystalline Crawler has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler.
Crystalline Crawler dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

147-892.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Sublime Epiphany
147-892.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Sublime Epiphany, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Sublime Epiphany, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-892.notes: You may choose more of Sublime Epiphany's modes, if desired.

2104-4125-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Shipwreck Dowser.
2104-4125-4305.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
The Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-2438-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.
